summary: Masimo filed an 8-K to update litigation related to its pending merger with Danaher Corporation. Under the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated February 16, 2026, a Danaher subsidiary will merge into Masimo, with Masimo surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. The special meeting is set for May 1, 2026. Three stockholder lawsuits and additional demand letters allege inadequate disclosures in the definitive proxy statement, seeking to enjoin the deal. Masimo believes the claims are without merit. This is a going-private acquisition by Danaher. The risk-arb angle is deal closure timing and disclosure litigation overhang.
